paragraphs: By leveraging advanced AI and NLP technologies, I can significantly contribute to Chattermill's mission to center customer feedback in decision-making processes. In my previous role, I built a tool-calling LLM agent using LangChain, AWS Bedrock, and Claude Haiku 4.5, integrating three tools for gene alias resolution, scoring-methodology explanation, and dataset provenance. This experience honed my skills in developing robust NLP workflows, which I can apply to Chattermill's advanced AI and NLP technologies.

Additionally, I developed NLP and agentic RAG workflows with Hugging Face Transformers, Ollama, LangChain, and LangGraph, further enhancing my ability to work with these technologies. These projects have equipped me with the skills to build and deploy sophisticated NLP solutions, aligning well with Chattermill's needs.
I have not used Chattermill's specific tools yet, but I am eager to bring my experience with LangChain, Hugging Face Transformers, and Ollama to your team.
